name: Pair a TV and send a routed title command
description: Verifies a paired TV receives a command containing platform, route status, and launch-target metadata.
steps: Select Google TV and complete pairing
Send a saved title to the paired TV
expected: The received command identifies Google TV and reports that a licensed native deep-link is needed.

name: Open the account and trial setup on mobile
description: Verifies the new account layer is accessible without disrupting the mobile organizer experience.
steps: Open the Stream Command account control
expected: The account form is visible with email and password fields, and the planned 72-hour premium trial is clearly described.

name: Live TV receiver reacts to phone commands
description: Verifies the TV receiver stays live after pairing and renders a phone-sent title command with the correct route state.
steps: Open Connect a TV and choose This screen is the TV
Select Browser / TV web and complete phone pairing
Send Yellowstone from the paired phone
expected: The receiver changes from Ready when you are to the Yellowstone command and automatically navigates to the provider fallback when a launch target is available.

name: Preserve provider catalog and watchlist
description: Verifies the account foundation leaves the core organizer workflows available.
steps: Open My Watchlist and view Where to watch
expected: Provider selection, watchlist titles, and Where to watch remain available.

name: Reject invalid account credentials before submission
description: Verifies incomplete account credentials are blocked before a Firebase authentication request is attempted.
steps: Enter an email and a password shorter than 6 characters
expected: A validation message explains the password requirement and the account request is not submitted.
